lessons.title: Types of Transport
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name different types of transport (land, air, water).
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how children travelled to school today.
lessons.main_activity: Sort transport picture cards into land, air, and water categories, discussing examples of each.
key_questions: What transport travels on land? In the air? On water?
How did you get to school today?

differentiation.extension: Sort into 3 categories and give multiple examples

lessons.assessment_notes: Note transport vocabulary and categorisation — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about different transport you've used.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'The Train Ride' or Similar Journey Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe the journey in the story.
lessons.main_activity: Read a journey-themed story, discussing what the character sees along the way.
key_questions: What did the character see on their journey?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and sequencing — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the journey story.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a journey you remember with your family.

lessons.title: Counting Wheels on Vehicles
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count and compare wheel numbers on different vehicles.
lessons.starter_activity: Count wheels on a bicycle vs a car picture.
lessons.main_activity: Children count wheels on various transport picture cards, comparing which has more/fewer.
key_questions: How many wheels does this have?

differentiation.extension: Count and compare multiple vehicles up to 10+ wheels combined

lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting and comparing accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.home_link: Count wheels on vehicles you see today.

lessons.title: Making a Vehicle Craft
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct a simple vehicle model using recycled materials.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at picture examples of different vehicles.
lessons.main_activity: Children build a vehicle (car, boat, or plane) using a cardboard box and craft materials, adding wheels/wings as appropriate.
resources_needed: Cardboard boxes, bottle caps (wheels), craft materials
key_questions: How did you attach the wheels/wings?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe construction planning and material joining skill — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Display vehicles together as a 'transport museum'.
lessons.home_link: Build a vehicle using recycling at home.

lessons.title: How Do Boats Float?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to observe and describe that some materials/shapes float on water.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict whether different materials will float or sink.
lessons.main_activity: Children test small objects/boat shapes in a water tray, observing and recording float/sink results.
key_questions: Why do you think it floats?

differentiation.extension: Test 5+ objects and predict before testing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation and early prediction skill — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what floated and what sank.
lessons.home_link: Test floating and sinking objects in the bath at home.

lessons.title: Phonics Recap and Consolidation Week
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and segment CVC words and digraph words fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire recap of all sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Mixed practice session consolidating all sounds/digraphs learned this term through games and reading activities.
resources_needed: Full set of flashcards, reading cards
key_questions: Can you blend this word quickly?
Can you segment this word into sounds?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note overall phonics fluency progress — informs ongoing tracker.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading a range of words over the week.

lessons.title: Transport Journey Maps: Positional Language
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a journey using positional/directional language.
lessons.main_activity: Using a simple journey map (road, tunnel, bridge), children describe a toy vehicle's journey using directional language.
key_questions: Where does the car go next?
Can you describe the whole journey?

differentiation.extension: Describe a full journey with 4+ directional words

lessons.assessment_notes: Note positional/directional language use — evidence for MATHS.2/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share journey descriptions with the group.
lessons.home_link: Describe a journey using directional words at home.

lessons.title: Role-Play: Bus/Train Journey
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to engage in imaginative role-play as passengers and a driver/conductor.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what happens on a bus/train journey.
lessons.main_activity: Free role-play setting up chairs as a bus/train, taking turns as driver, conductor, and passengers using imaginative language.
resources_needed: Chairs, play tickets, steering wheel prop

differentiation.extension: Child extends the scenario with own ideas

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe imaginative role-play and social language — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Share where everyone's journey went today.
lessons.home_link: Play a pretend bus/train journey at home.

lessons.title: How Do Planes Fly?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe simply what helps a plane fly.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how birds fly using wings.
lessons.main_activity: Make simple paper aeroplanes and test throwing them, discussing how the wings help it glide/fly.

differentiation.extension: Experiment with different fold designs and compare distances

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation of flight — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.home_link: Make and fly a paper aeroplane together at home.

lessons.title: Writing a Travel Journal Entry
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write about a journey using known sounds.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap a journey discussed earlier in the week.
lessons.main_activity: Children draw and attempt to write a simple sentence about a journey (e.g. 'I went on a bus') using known phonics sounds.

differentiation.extension: Independent phonetic attempt at a short sentence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress and sentence attempt — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share travel journal entries with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write about a journey together at home.

lessons.title: Timetables: Simple Sequencing
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sequence a simple journey timetable using time vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Sequence picture cards showing stages of a journey (leave home, wait, travel, arrive) using before/after language.
key_questions: What happens before you get on the bus?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note early time-sequencing understanding — evidence for MATHS.1/UTW.1.
lessons.home_link: Talk about the sequence of your journey to school.

lessons.title: Transport Long Ago vs Now
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare old and modern forms of transport.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a picture of an old-fashioned car/train vs a modern one.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss and compare old and new transport, noting changes (steam trains vs electric trains, horse and cart vs cars).
resources_needed: Old vs modern transport picture cards
key_questions: What is different about this old transport?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of change over time — evidence for UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap how transport has changed over time.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member how they used to travel when they were young.

lessons.title: Retelling a Journey Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell a journey-themed story with beginning, middle, and end.
lessons.main_activity: In small groups, children retell the story using toy vehicles as props, supported by a story map.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note full narrative retelling ability — evidence for LIT.1/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: One group performs their retelling to the class.
lessons.home_link: Retell the journey story to your family.

lessons.title: Vehicle Shape Sorting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sort vehicles by shape features (round wheels, rectangular bodies).
lessons.main_activity: Children identify and sort vehicle picture cards by the shapes used in their design (wheels=circles, body=rectangle).
resources_needed: Vehicle picture cards, shape overlay stencils
lessons.assessment_notes: Note shape recognition application — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of shapes found in vehicle designs.
lessons.home_link: Look for shapes in vehicles you see today.

lessons.title: Transport Song and Dance: 'Wheels on the Bus'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sing a transport-themed song with actions and invent a new verse.
lessons.starter_activity: Sing the familiar 'Wheels on the Bus' song.
lessons.main_activity: Perform the song with actions, then create a new verse about a different vehicle (e.g. 'the wings on the plane go up and down').
key_questions: Can you think of a new verse?
What actions go with your new verse?

differentiation.extension: Suggest and lead an original verse

lessons.assessment_notes: Note creative contribution and performance confidence — evidence for EAD.2/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform all the new verses created together.
lessons.home_link: Sing the song with your new verse for family.

lessons.title: Transport and Journeys Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about transport and journeys learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Transport and Journeys' display summarising types of transport, floating/flying, and change over time.
key_questions: What have we learned about transport?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.2/UTW.1.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about transport with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: Full Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC and digraph words fluently in simple sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, reading cards, simple sentence reading with mixed CVC and digraph words.
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update overall phonics tracker with consolidation progress.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress with a big reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Position, Time Sequencing
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, positional, and time-sequencing skills learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting vehicle wheels, journey map positional language, journey timetable sequencing.
key_questions: What happens next in the journey?
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting and sequencing over the weekend.

lessons.title: Transport Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the transport song with confidence, including invented verses.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class performance of 'Wheels on the Bus' and invented verses, with vehicle craft displayed as a 'transport museum'.
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the transport week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the song for family this weekend.
